description: HSE approval date set to the ODMS effective date for pertuzumab (2014-02-01): the HSE Cancer Drugs Approved for Reimbursement list (last updated 2026-07-17) lists pertuzumab, February 2014, ODMS, for the treatment of adult patients with HER2-positive MBC or locally recurrent unresectable breast cancer who have not received previous anti-HER2 therapy or chemotherapy for their metastatic disease. This is the same entry used for 00204:a, 00507:a and 00726:a.
